stem: Which atom is shown in the following figure? (A Bohr-model diagram showing a central nucleus surrounded by two electron shells: an inner shell with 2 electrons and an outer shell with 6 electrons.)

Which type of bond is displayed in the following figure? (Two identical overlapping circles representing two atoms, with a shared pair of electrons \(\times\times\) in the overlap region and no partial charges marked.)

Which of the following is a correct setup for verifying the law of conservation of mass in a chemical reaction before the solution is mixed? (Four sealed conical-flask setups labelled a, b, c and d, each containing one reactant solution with a small inner tube holding the second reactant: in a the inner tube lies tilted on the solution surface, in b the inner tube stands upright clear of the solution, in c the inner tube hangs from the top dipping into the solution, and in d the inner tube stands but is partly submerged in the solution.)

The bond displayed in this figure is ________. (Two overlapping circles representing two atoms sharing a pair of electrons \(\times\times\), with the left atom marked "Partial +" and the right atom marked "Partial -".)

Which type of bond is displayed in the following figure? (Two overlapping atoms of different size sharing a pair of electrons \(\times\times\) in the overlap region; the smaller atom on the left is marked "+" and the larger atom on the right is marked "-", with the shared pair shifted toward the larger atom.)
